letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Your laughter is my favorite soundtrack, and your smile turns ordinary moments into fireworks. I love how we blend cultures, cuisines, and countless “cutie” nicknames into our story. As the calendar flips, I’m grateful for every second we’ve stolen together and all the adventures that still await us. You are my forever home, wherever we are.
poem:
In desert dunes or Gujarat’s rain,
Your love’s the rhythm in my vein.
With you, each day’s a sweet refrain,
My heart beats “Liza,” again and again.
